purpose: Portable proof object for a specific reviewed Shine application release.
rules: The receipt must exactly match one reviewed entry in the ecosystem profile ledger.
Every policy id in the receipt must exist in the canonical Defence registry.
The registry version/blob in the receipt identifies the reviewed canonical policy set used for the receipt.
The release-claim contract version/blob must match the canonical release-claim entry.
A receipt is evidence for its exact reviewed release only and is not inherited by later app commits.
nonClaims: A receipt does not prove software is invulnerable.
A receipt does not replace app-specific tests or release verification.
A receipt does not certify later commits unless a new reviewed receipt is issued.
